r1-0.notes: Best match: beret+crescent pin and clip, silver bob with long side lock, sleepy light-blue eyes, navy coat with tails, black tights. Rifle upright muzzle-up in her hand (muzzle has a second parallel rod, minor). Open gloved hand toward lens, 5 fingers. Bell arch, parapet, slate roofs. Skirt above knee over black tights (as her current portrait), no thigh focus.

r1-1.notes: Good likeness and rich roofs/spires/bell. Rifle carried across body, muzzle down-right (not upright as spec); not aimed at viewer. Reaching glove fine.

r1-2.notes: Waving glove 5 fingers; rifle on shoulder diagonal, muzzle up-left out of frame. Background mostly sky + one building, thinner than others. Camera reads near eye level.

r1-3.notes: Rifle malformed: oversized blocky axe-like stock, two stacked scopes; reads as a wrong prop. Likeness ok.

r1-4.notes: Rifle slung behind her back, only a barrel tip over the shoulder: reads as missing (spec notes say slung = missing).

r1-5.notes: Strong runner-up: rifle on shoulder, muzzle out to the side over the roofs, reaching glove 5 fingers, rich tower roofs and sea. No bell visible.

r1-6.notes: Rifle held diagonally muzzle-down, scope objective faces the lens; not aimed at viewer but not upright. Rooftop walkway background.

checklist.likeness: yes - beret with crescent pin, crescent clip, silver bob + long side lock, sleepy light-blue eyes, navy coat/gold trim, black tights
